description: This PHP file provides functions to generate XML, HTML, and WML fragments for displaying motherboard information such as temperature, fan speeds, and voltages. It interacts with a global $mbinfo object to retrieve data and formats it for system monitoring interfaces.

methods.name: xml_mbtemp
methods.description: Generates XML segment for motherboard temperature data.

methods.name: xml_mbfans
methods.description: Generates XML segment for motherboard fan data.

methods.name: xml_mbvoltage
methods.description: Generates XML segment for motherboard voltage data.

methods.name: html_mbtemp
methods.description: Produces HTML table rows visualizing motherboard temperature data.

methods.name: html_mbfans
methods.description: Produces an HTML table with motherboard fan speeds.

methods.name: html_mbvoltage
methods.description: Produces an HTML table with motherboard voltage readings.

methods.name: wml_mbtemp
methods.description: Generates WML for motherboard temperature data.

methods.name: wml_mbfans
methods.description: Generates WML for motherboard fan data.

methods.name: wml_mbvoltage
methods.description: Generates WML for motherboard voltage data.
